reviews.text: I can not express enough the deep gratitude that I have for Dr. Olson and Clare.  They came to my home the same day I called to help me say goodbye to my deeply loved cat, Otis. It was as if two dear friends showed up at my home to hold my hand and offer loving support during a time of grief.  They clearly have a calling for the work they do and it is a gift to the owner and their fur babies.  They are incredible human beings and it radiates from their presence. Their patience and care was beyond what I could have hoped for.  The entire experience was calm and peaceful without rush or fear.  They took their time to talk to me and answer questions and affirm what I already knew in my heart.  I could not have asked for a more beautiful goodbye. I was able to hold my baby the entire time and was given the time and space to do so. I will forever be grateful. If I could give you 1,000 stars, I would.  I will always reach out to Dr. Olson and his team for any future vet needs.
Dr. Olson and his team were excellent in helping us through this difficult time.  I also appreciate the personal follow-up from his office.

We had to say goodbye to our German Shepherd this past week. I can’t begin to thank Dallas Veterinary Hospice staff for their services and support. Everyone from the receptionist to the vet tech to funeral home director to Dr. Olson were class acts and incredibly compassionate. Grateful for these good people.

I'm so grateful that Dallas Veterinary Hospice exists, that they fit us in when our family needed them, and for both Tays and Dr. Olson. Their team preserved my dog’s dignity and were so wonderful to us. No one wants to have to make this call, but DVH does hard and magnificent work and I would wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone else in a similar situation.
They were fantastic at this devastating time for us. Thanks to Dr Olson and his team.

Dr Olsen and his team were wonderful during a challenging time for our family. Being able to say goodbye to our beloved Reggie at home was a very peaceful option (for him and us). Dr Olsen showed compassion and professionalism. Thank you from me and my entire family!

Dr Williams was compassionate, graceful, and efficient in her care for our challenging girl. The doctor was thorough in her explanations, and our pup's last moments were peaceful as they could have been.  Well done.

I had to lay my dog to rest in August of 2025, and I'd had him since I was seventeen and he lived for 15 years so he was more than just a pet to me, he was truly my best friend and my biggest confidant, so I wanted to ensure that he had a comfortable and seamless passing. I used the hospice, at home service, and the doctor, Sydney, came to our home and she provided outstanding services. She made my dog feel comfortable during the euthanasia process and she treated our family with a lot of empathy as we said our good-byes to him. Then, the paw printing, the cremation, and the hair clippings were packaged nicely to forever remember my best friend. Absolutely use this service because it's the best way to lay your pet to rest, even though it's such a painful process.

It has been a month since DVH helped my fur baby pass peacefully.  I’ve been mourning so my review is late but deserved. From start to finish the entire staff were absolutely amazing. The office ladies were kind and respectful, loving and supportive. Dr. Olson (Dr.Daniel) was amazing above 5 stars. He came over on a Friday night at 8:30pm after hours so my wife could be home with me after she got off work. He was so kind and has a heart the size of Texas. I would and will use these wonderful humans again when it’s time for my other fur babies. I can’t not stress enough that if you are in this horrible situation and don’t know what to do these are the professionals that made it as amazing as it could be. Up front prices ( fairest prices in Dallas) and worth every cent to take care my Bella dog. I could write a book on kindness and compassion and pure love of Dr. Olson and the entire staff. From myself and wife we send appreciation and love. 1-5 stars I’d give 100 stars.

I honestly never thought I would want to put my sweet baby to sleep. I thought God would take her when it was time for her to go. But when she started crying in pain each day,  didn't even want to get up to eat anymore and nothing seemed to help it broke my heart. After my family agreed, we called and they walked through what was going on with her and agreed that it was time to help her along to her next life. Every single moment of this process was met with compassion. From the first call to the time her ashes were dropped off to us. Dr. Davis was amazing. As hard as this was on my family, being able to be at home, and having Dr. Davis tell us what to expect every step of the way made a devastating experience bearable. It helped my children and my other dogs say goodbye in a way they never would have been able to in a vets office. Your heart will still break...but it will hurt a little less if you use Dallas Veterinary Hospice. ❤
Dr. Olson was fantastic. Being able to have our pet's final moments be in our home was worth every penny.

Dr. Olsen came to our home and helped our cat peacefully and comfortably pass away. Dr. Olsen and the staff made the entire process go smoothly. He was very patient and kind when he arrived. He did not rush us in saying our goodbyes. He clearly explained to us everything he was doing and answered any questions we had. We held our cat in her final moments in the home she loved surrounded by her entire family. I would recommend this service, and especially Dr. Olsen, to anyone who has to make the hard decision to let their pet go.

Dr. Olson and his team were the perfect balance of professional and compassionate. We were distraught when the time to put our dog to sleep came harder and faster than expected, but it was very easy to book with Dr. Olson for a same day appointment. His staff reached out by text to confirm, and he arrived very punctually within the timeframe we selected. We received prompt follow up for memorial items the next day.

We were very grateful for Dr. Olson’s empathetic care that allowed Rufus to pass peacefully and comfortably at home with his human and dog family around him. I would recommend this business without hesitation and will use this veterinarian for routine care for our other geriatric dogs.
Thank you for taking care of my beloved Kiah.   she will be missed.

Dr. Davis was so sweet to our senior dog. She came to our house for an end of life consultation, and really helped us set up a plan to manage our senior dog’s osteoarthritis pain. She provided 1:1 quality care and took the time to fully examine our dog and answer our questions/concerns. My dog has always hated vet visits but she loved Dr Davis. She had all procedures done from the comfort of her own favorite spot on the couch- so much less stressful than our normal vet visits. She was super easy to get in contact with and is able to see our dog on short notice. It is very refreshing to meet a vet who truly loves her job and our pets.

Dr. Davis truly understands the drama of the decision that her patients are facing. Her calm and loving demeanor is so welcome in the moment of uncertainty.
She gives you time and respect during this devastating situation 💔. …

The loss of Molly, our 15-year-old Beagle happened far more quickly than we ever expected.
Dr. Davis came to our home on a Saturday evening and met us with such kindness, patience, and genuine care.
She was incredibly gentle and attentive, speaking softly and moving at Molly’s pace, always making sure she was comfortable and at peace.
Being able to say goodbye at home, without feeling rushed, brought a sense of calm to an otherwise heartbreaking moment, and we are so incredibly grateful to Dr. Davis for the compassion she showed our family.
The staff at Dallas Veterinary Hospital were very compassionate.  This was a very hard time for us but they made sure to make it as comfortable as possible.  Dr. Tran was wonderful.  Thank you all!

From the initial contact, Dr. Olsen and her team did everything they could to walk along with me during this overwhelmingly challenging period.
It is never easy making the decision to say goodbye to your best friend, especially after 15 years together, and choosing the right person to be in that space is important. Knowing my dog was loved and cared for in the manner he was I’d recommend Dallas Veterinary Hospice to anyone who may need it.

Dr Davis empathy and professionalism during our very difficult last moments with our Border Collie of 14 years in our home made the process easier to accept. Her heartfelt emotional support was genuine and appreciated.
During such a difficult time, Dr. Olson and Veronica were professional and compassionate throughout the whole process. I would definitely recommend them.

Dr Olson and his assistant were kind and compassionate in assisting us with our final goodbye for our precious kitty. It was very peaceful to do this at home, and Dallas Veterinary Hospice made the entire process go smoothly.

Dr Davis was amazing helping our Tito cross the Rainbow Bridge.  She was caring and concerned and super empathetic to what we were going through while losing a beloved elderly pet.  Would highly recommend this for anyone wanting a more private, home-based experience.

Dr. Davis took excellent care of us when we had to say goodbye to our 17 year old dachshund. It was an experience I didn’t want to go through but she was so sweet to our little buddy and was extremely kind during the process. The world needs more Dr. Davis’. Thank you!!!!

Dr. Davis was very kind, compassionate and comforting when she came to help end my pets suffering. The service she provided is truly appreciated. He got to pass in the comfort of his own home in my lap. No stress or unfamiliar surroundings. I will always be grateful for that. Thank you Dr. Davis.

Dallas Veterinary Hospice was introduced to us through Peaceful Pets DFW. They helped us with the toughest decision of our life. They did not rush us, and the at home euthanasia was done with care and love.

This was the absolute best case scenario for a bad situation. Both the Dr. and her friend were so supportive and caring. I highly recommend their services for anyone who sadly may need it in the future.
i spent 9 years with my kitty and Dr. Davis gave us a beautiful last day with him i am eternally grateful
Thank you for making a challenging time very calm and peaceful.

I would like to thank Dallas veterinary hospice for their kindness and compassion. Knowing are dog Moose was in his own home surrounded by the love of his family made this difficult decision a little easier. Thank you Dr Tran for your kindness and giving me validation that I was making the right decision I will forever be grateful.
Thank you so much ❤️
In such a hard time these two ladies made it much easier for us all. The vet made our baby comfortable thru the whole process.  I highly recommend this service.

Our 12 year old German Shepherd was unable to walk within a day. Dallas veterinary hospital arrived the next day. They were very caring and compassionate. Now, my baby is in heaven without suffering. Thank you so much🙏🥲 …

Our sweet girl Murcie was declining and getting worse with Doggy Dementia and we began our search for an at-home euth service as we did not want to take her into a clinic.
We were able to make the appointment for a date and time that worked for us. On the day prior, the doctor for our appointment had a family emergency and the staff was able to locate another doctor to fill in for our needs.
Dr. Tran was so kind, spoke quietly and softly, and showed our girl love as well.
Even though we had time to love and dote on our girl before the appointment, Dr. Tran gave us all the time we wanted and needed with our baby.
The overall experience was exactly what we were hoping it would be as we said our final goodbyes to our sweet girl

We have received exceptional service from Dr. Olson.

He was fantastic: courteous, sympathetic, and understanding of our entire situation. Dr. Olson recognized the urgency of our issues and made an exception to come during the evening for euthanasia services.

We had contacted several other veterinarians, and Dr. Olson was the only one able to accommodate us, for which we are truly grateful.

Thank you for being a part of the last moments of Cashew life. Thank you for putting us in ease and so comforting with the whole process as we said goodbye to our love one.

Our sweet cat was at the end of his life and Dr Olson and his assistant Victoria could not have been any more kind and considerate. They allowed us as much time as we wanted with our boy. They are extremely competent with end of life procedures and care.

Throughout the entire process, Dallas Veterinary Hospice have been great. After I had called to schedule an appointment for in-home euthanasia, Dr. Davis text me soon after to give me an ETA of when she would arrive at my house. The first text she sent me was very positive and reassuring. When Dr. Davis arrived at my house, she was very comforting and empathetic. She explained the process and assured me that my Gracie would be going in peace and with dignity. She answered any questions or concerns that I had. It was one of the hardest decisions I've had to make, but I knew it was right one for Gracie. Thank you, Dr. Davis, for making it a little easier!

Dr Olson and Veronica are absolutely top notch!  While having to deal with one of the most stressful experiences of my life, their kind professionalism made it all seem bearable. While Yuma was our last dog, I’m keeping their information in my phone so that I may refer them to friends and family. Highly recommend!!
Dr.Davis made something so awful feel more manageable by providing comfort and guidance as we said goodbye to our sweet dog Jack after 15 years. Thank you Dr.Davis.

We had to say goodbye to our sweet boy, Finn, last week. It was an incredibly hard day, but thanks to the compassion and love from Dr. Davis, what could have been unbearable became a time of peace and reflection—remembering all the wonderful memories we shared with him.
Brandie, the receptionist, stayed in touch with us throughout the day and was so kind and patient whenever we had questions. Once Dr. Davis was on her way, Brandie let us know and took the time to explain everything so we could feel calm and a little more at ease.
I can’t thank Dr. Davis and Brandie enough for their kindness and compassion on one of the hardest days of our lives. It truly warms my heart knowing there are angels like them who are so clearly meant to do what they do.
Thank you for giving Finn such a peaceful and gentle send-off in the comfort of home. We will never forget your kindness.

Could not have asked for a better experience , under the circumstances . This was an emergency , not planned . Dallas Veterinary went out of their way to help , when others could not. They were very compassionate and loving to our girl Dottie .Went out of their way to explain every step , so we knew what to expect during the process . We elected the communal cremation , and their rep was there to take her remains directly to their facility . Everyone was so kind and respectful , when we needed it the most . Highly recommend this team .

Dr. Davis was fantastic. It is hard thing to do putting a beloved pet down and she was so sincere and kind walking through every step, giving plenty of time, offering some beautiful words in the final moments, etc. Truly a blessing having her help get through the process.
Highly recommend, our Vet was amazing through it all and comforted the entire family. Thanks for everything!

We so appreciated the compassionate care we received from the Dallas Veterinary Hospice team. It is a very difficult decision to let a loved pet go, but from the first phone call to the last moments with Dr. Davis, we received gentle, compassionate understanding, which helped us through a difficult time. Dr. Davis was kind, thoughtful, and careful to explain everything.  She wanted us and Toby to be as comfortable as possible, inviting questions and offering comfort to all of us. She took wonderful care of our sweet Toby on his last day, and we are so appreciative.

Extremely compassionate and understanding of the needs of both you and your pet. If you find yourself in the position of having to say goodbye to a beloved pet, do yourself the absolute favor of going through Dallas Veterinary Hospice. I have taken pets to a regular clinic in the past and the difference is absolutely night and day. Everything is settled up front so you can just focus on saying goodbye with love when the time comes in the comfort of the environment you and your pet are most at ease in.

I cannot recommend them enough.
Dr. Tran was great, and really patient with our autistic daughter.  He really seemed to try his best to make it as non-traumatic as possible.

Dr March was the one that  came to our home to euthanize our lovely  dog, she was really supportive during the whole process. We are really thankful with her she treated Laika with a lot of love and respect. The services provided by  the Dallas veterinary hospice was quick on responding with questions and really helpful with the whole process , we really recommend their services.

Hardest thing I ever had to do was to schedule this for my 18yr old dog.  Took me several times to fill in the forms online before I completed them.  As hard as it was to let him go, they made the whole process easy and were very accommodating.  I would highly recommend them for this process.

We recently had to say goodbye to our beloved 10-year-old Willow, and while it was one of the hardest moments of our lives, Dr. Davis made the experience as peaceful and meaningful as possible. She was compassionate, empathetic, and truly attentive—not only to Willow, but also to our younger dog Boo, giving him the love and reassurance he needed while saying goodbye to his big sister.

What touched us the most was how Dr. Davis honored a long-time promise we had made to Willow. Out of pure kindness, she brought chocolate cake, something Willow had never been able to enjoy. In her final moments, Willow perked up with joy and devoured three warm slices. It was such a beautiful and unexpected gift that we will cherish forever.

We cannot thank Dr. Davis enough for her care, compassion, and the way she helped us through such a difficult time. In the middle of heartbreak, she gave us a memory of Willow that we will hold close for the rest of our lives.

Everyone I spoke with or came to my home were compassionate kind and concerned about me and Bandit. Dr Davis explained the process was never in a hurry. I felt that I had found the best people to handle this for us.
Our large dog was put down at home. Dr Muchand(hope that is spelled right) was professional and very kind. Thank you

When I needed an urgent house call for euthanasia, Dr. Davis came the same day. She was gentle and compassionate, making sure my dog was comfortable and at peace in her final moments. It was the best goodbye I could have hoped for. I’m very grateful and would highly recommend.
I cannot put into words how Dr. Davis made this unbearable process feel calming, not just for the humans, but also for my baby Max. I am forever grateful. Christine

We had to say goodbye to our 17-year-old dog, Ginger, this week. I was able to schedule the appointment with Dallas Veterinary Hospice online about 48 hours in advance, and every communication we received from that moment on was compassionate, clear, and supportive.

Dr. Davis was absolutely wonderful. She comforted us while giving our sweet girl the gentlest sendoff. She even brought some chocolate cake for Ginger, which was such a special last treat for her. Dr. Davis never rushed us, allowing all the time and space we needed to say goodbye.

No pet owner ever wants to be in this situation, but when the inevitable time comes, this service is invaluable. We are deeply grateful to Dallas Veterinary Hospice for helping our Ginger cross the rainbow bridge with peace and dignity.

On Monday, August 11, Dr. Davis came to my home to euthanize my 17-year-old cat. She talked nonstop from the time she and her assistant entered. I wanted a quiet, peaceful final minutes with my beloved pet. Instead I got chatter and the sharing of her "beliefs" after death, etc. I was sobbing too hard to tell her to be quiet. She intruded on my grief and I will never use this service again.

My girl Maya was very sick, she was 14 and her health had declined rapidly, i had to make the hardest decision in my life, i had to let her go and rest in peace. I called other places but had three day waiting list but the kind ladies at this clinic scheduled me for the next day. Dr Davis arrived on time and she was the sweetest person, the right person to comfort my son and i and she also was very kind to Maya. Dr Davis made brownies the night prior and shared them with Maya. She kept us calm and reassuring us every step of the way that Maya was not gonna be in pain. It was quick and my sweet girl died on my lap, never wished to see this but im grateful i got to hold her till her last breath. I hope no one has to go through this but if you ever do please trust this young lady with your beloved baby. We will forever remember you Dr Davis, you are a good soul, takes someone with lots of compassion and you have it, thank you

During this difficult time for my family, I am so glad we reached out to Dallas Veterinary Hospice. Dr Davis was so amazing and compassionate and treated our Boomer like 1 of her own. She even brought him a Chocolate Cake!!! Thank you so much for everything. I highly recommend this amazing Team!!!
Dr. Davis allowed me and my little guy a peaceful transition at home. Forever grateful for her compassion, walking me through everything and even bringing a special final treat.

The interaction with the staff / doctors and their; support, compassion,  and respect for us as pet owners was above and beyond my expectations. Dr. Davis was honest and straight forward, with a tenderhearted approach.

We recently reached out to Dallas Veterinary Hospice when we needed to euthanize our pet: The office staff particularly Mariana and Dr. Davis were so kind and thoughtful during the whole process. Everything was explained and all questions answered.. I would  highly recommend them.

My dogs health declined very fast and I needed urgent euthanasia services. Their office was quick to reach out to me. The communication/response time was amazing. Dr. Davis stayed in communication with me until she arrived to my house. During the procedure she walked us through and explained everything. She was so kind💕. I couldn't imagine a better experience for my doggy than what was provided. She is truly amazing at what she does.

Dr. Davis helped us with my cat Salem, who was 13. Even though I am still grieving, I just want to say that Dr. Davis was so incredibly kind, thoughtful, and empathetic when we put Salem to sleep. She walked us through each step, gave us space to grieve, and made sure Salem was happy and comfortable. She is truly an amazing human - it takes a special kind of person to do what she does. Forever grateful for her service and completely worth it. Thank you Dr. Davis for being so kind and grieving with us in that moment - I will never forget it.

Dr. Tran was amazing. He was so patient and caring and kind. Truly helped to make a terrible situation the best and most peaceful it could be. Upon going to pick up my baby’s ashes, the presentation was lovely, slipping
Of fur, engraved urn and paw print. I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Helped making the terrible day a little easier. ❤️ I will use Dr. Tran again.
We’ve had to put down 2 of our furbabies this year. The people on this team are literal angels on earth. I’m so grateful for them and their compassion.

I cannot say enough about Dallas Veterinary Hospice.  I am si grateful for them and their team.  From Sydney who initially responded to my text, to Dr. Davis, I could not have been more blessed in this most difficult situation. Sydney was kind, understanding, and efficient in assisting me with my emergency needs and Dr. Davis was an Angel. She is one of the most kindest, caring individuals I have ever had the opportunity to know. She made one of the most difficult times in mine and my families lives much more tolerable. I will be forever grateful and appreciative of their guidance, caring, and kindness.
Everyone from the people answering the phones to the doctor who performed the procedure were caring, efficient, and made a difficult time easier for me and my companion of 13 years. Thanks to all.

I scheduled an at-home appointment with Dallas Veterinary Hospice initially for later this coming week. However, when my baby Dory Lane took a rapid decline, I reached out again out of desperation/emergency about moving my appointment up to Saturday morning. From the initial text-contact, I was treated with such care/compassion (even through text), and they were able to make a sudden Saturday morning emergency appointment happen! Dr. Davis was so calming/caring, brought my Dory Lane chocolate cake, walked me through the whole process whilst keeping me distracted from the hardest decision I’ve ever had to make. For any one that is doubting, at-home end of life services with Dallas Veterinary Hospice is totally the way to go. 10/10 for me. Very affordable in comparison to most at-home services around. Thanks again Dr. Davis for taking such care of my Dory and I, I’ll never forget that kindness!

Sweet, sweet Dr. Davis...I don't even have the words to express how you made what was one of the worst days of my son's life, peaceful. I don't think anyone else could have put him at ease like you did. Saying good bye to his baby girl was tough but you...you were amazing at walking him through every step and just reassuring him that everything he did and was feeling was ok. I will never forget you... ever. Thank you for making my fur grandbabys last moments so peaceful and the chocolate cake...home made at that...you are an angel. I will recommend you to everyone. The love you have for animals and humans shows...in your eyes...your smile...your soul. To anyone reading this, search no more for someone to come to your home and help your baby transition...these are your people. I truly mean that. Dr. DAVIS...again, thank you...our Dory Lane loved you...we love you. 🩷

Saying Dr. Olson was amazing does not even begin to cover it. He made a very hard moment as easy as possible. I was saying goodbye to my cat Daisy, which was very difficult. Dr. Olson had a calm, warm, compassionate demeanor and explained everything from the start. He moved as slowly as we wanted, brought a treat for her, even gave us private time to say goodbye. It was the most peaceful way for her to go and it might it so much easier on me. I highly recommend using Dr. Olson and Dallas Veterinary Hospice whenever it's time to say goodbye to your beloved pet.

Dr. Olson and his staff are angels. I am so thankful I found out about them. We had to put one of my dogs to rest, and he was very helpful in helping me make the final decision and to do what was best for her. He is very personable and friendly, and someone I would trust full heartedly when the time comes again. Do not let your pet suffer in its final moments by taking it to the vets office, the place they are terrified of.
Thank you ❤️
Great veterinarian and great people! Highly recommend!

I new the time was approaching for Fifi. When I asked about service hrs. They told me " there is no way to plan for this, we have flexible hrs." That helped so much during the process. Dr. Dan came with a chocolate cup cake, fifi loved it.

The Doctor made an extremely difficult time as peaceful and reassuring as possible. He was kind, gentle and respectful of our 14 1/2 year old Rottie. Our family was able to be close to Emma and love on her until the last moment. The Doctor and Nurse were true professionals.

This was the first time that we had a Vet come to our house. My only regret is that I didn’t do this with our other senior dogs over the years. In-home was so much less stressful for Emma and our family. It feels strange to say  but now that time has gone by, my memories of her last moments are really warm. There is peace in knowing that you did the best you could for your pet until the very end. It was the farewell she deserved.
Thank you!

Saying goodbye to a beloved dog is never easy, but being able to do it at home—where they feel most comfortable—offers some comfort during such a difficult time. Dr. Davis was incredibly kind and compassionate, walking us through each step so we knew exactly what to expect. She even brought treats for our sweet Charlie, including a bit of chocolate—his first ever in 14 years. It was touching to see him enjoy something new, even in his final moments. The process was peaceful and smooth. We’re so grateful to Dallas Veterinary Hospice and highly recommend their services.

It was one of the hardest decisions I've made in a long time. Diego was my pet, my friend, and my companion for over 16 years. His regular vet was out of town at the time. We made several calls around, and  then we called a friend of a friend . Dr. Davis was able to come to the house and take care of our needs. Diego spent his last hours at home with his family. Dr. Davis was just outstanding with the way she took care of our baby. We could not have asked for more.

The doctor was wonderful with our sweet Libby. She was 14 years old. And we loved her dearly.  Our hearts are broken, but we take comfort in sweet and gentle care - provided by the Dr. She was absolutely awesome with her and us.

Dr. Davis was truly amazing during this very difficult time. She explained the procedure, answered our questions and allowed our beloved Macey of 16 years to go to Heaven peacefully at home. Dr. Davis was empathetic and allowed us all the time we needed to say our goodbyes. Thank you Dr. Davis and the staff at Dallas Veterinary Hospice for the support and kind words.

What a compassionate team. As hard as it was to make this appointment for our 17.5 year old Jack Russell, I am happy I made it with Dallas Veterinary Hospice. Dr Davis was compassionate and explained each step to my husband and I. She allowed us to speak about the great memories we had with our fur baby and gave us all peace on a day that was weighed with so much emotion. Thank you for being there to help us all through this transition.

Dr Dan is very compassionate in evaluating Mia and providing options of care to address her issues as she is an advanced senior.  Veronica was also very good with Mia when she gave immunizations.  I thought Mia would have been gone six months ago, but due to this care, is still enjoying life.

Made a very difficult day much easier by giving our fur baby a gentle passing and bringing to an end months of struggle. We appreciate the flexibility in working us into a full schedule and the time they gave us to mourn as a family.

Dr Dan was our angel! He came to the house to help our
baby, Coco, cross over. He was patient with us explaining the process and allowing us to proceed at our own pace. He treated us and our baby with dignity and respect. Giving us all the time we needed to proceed. Before leaving with Coco, he provided detailed information about where our girl was being taken and what would be happening afterwards. He left detailed contact information with us so we would be able to check with him on the progress with the process. He did his best to make an unbearable situation as painless as possible.

When our sweet Rosco took a quick turn for the worse, Dr Davis was able to come out the same day on a Sunday!  She was kind and compassionate and explained exactly to us what to expect,  she was professional and very respectful of the emotions we were going through.  Rosco was able to cross that rainbow bridge gently with dignity, along with some chocolate treats right at the end, I am sure he passed with a smile on his face with the the people who loved him surrounding him in his own home.  Would highly recommend this service.

The Dr. that came out was so very comforting about our situation and explained a lot . She helped us through the process and was extremely professional.  It's so nice to know that our loving fur baby Mookee was handled with so much love and  compassion . She helped in ways you can't put in words, and we so appreciate the job She did and how she handled our boy . Much thanks to her with all she did . She was wonderful .

This was the absolute right choice for our precious German Shepard. I'd never used this service for at home, but aside from the cost, it went smoothly. The doctor was very knowledgeable and compassionate, explaining everything in detail.

If you are in a pinch and need euthanasia right away, I don't think it's a great fit because you need an appointment versus showing up at the emergency vet for this purpose.

I understand it should cost more for a big dog. However, 400$ plus 150$ to travel from Dallas to Red Oak was the most distressing part of the whole thing. I can get to Dallas and back in less than 40 minutes and less than a quarter tank of gas. This is why I only gave a 4 star. Hope this information helps others.

During a very emotional and trying time, Dr Olson eased our sweet cat along his next journey with compassion and care. There was no pain. No stress. Just all the love. Putting a beloved pet to sleep is never an easy decision. We do it to ease their suffering. But being able to do it at home under the guidance and expertise of Dr. Olson made all the difference. It made the goodbye easier, not one weighed down by fear and mourning but a goodbye that was felt more like a loving release. We'll be forever grateful for those last few moments and how special they were thanks to Dr. Olson and Dallas Veterinary Hospice.

Dr. Davis was an angel sent from above who helped us help our Achilles transition to rainbow bridge. We had our old guy for fourteen years. Dr. Davis was so kind and patient, I will never forget the words she was saying to us to help us understand what was happening. I thank Dallas Veterinary Hospice for being very accommodating same day. We thank you for helping out our boy one last time.

I used DVH when it was my baby Rory’s time to cross the rainbow bridge. Brandie was extremely helpful in answering my questions about the process. When Dr. Davis arrived, she was very kind and informative about what would take place. She was very kind in saying she could tell how loved my Rory was/is. DVH made this the best experience it could possibly be in these circumstances. Thank you both for everything.

Highly recommend! Dr Olson made our sweet Biggie’s last moments so peaceful. He was incredibly compassionate and skilled. My dog had no fear or pain during the process. I miss him terribly but I am comforted knowing I was able to give him this last mercy
